description:
Recursively scan the working directory (and subdirectories) for files named exactly `CHECKS.md`, producing the list of files to parse. Use the `ignore` crate (already a dependency — the ripgrep walker) for a fast, parallel, gitignore-aware walk rooted at the working directory. Default to respecting `.gitignore`; document the decision.
